overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing colonist psychology state transitions for zero-allocation performance, and establishing a fixed-point physics accumulator for endgame stability.

tasks.title: Implement Deterministic State Hashing for Save/Load Integrity
acceptance_criteria: StateHash produces identical uint64_t values across 1000 Monte Carlo runs.
Zero heap allocations during hash computation.
Compile-time evaluation supported for static constants.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Guarantees 100% reproducible saves, eliminating desync errors in long-term campaigns.

tasks.title: Fixed-Point Physics Accumulator for Endgame Stability
acceptance_criteria: Accumulator handles overflow via modulo arithmetic if needed.
Header-only implementation with no external dependencies.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Prevents physics jitter in late-game scenarios, ensuring smooth visual interpolation.

tasks.title: Zero-Alloc Colonist Psychology State Machine
acceptance_criteria: State transitions occur in O(1) time.
No virtual functions or heap allocations.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster AI decision loops, reducing frame time spikes during large colony events.
